name: Rung-1 LLM-native bounded-register benchmark harness alignment
purpose: Record the current progress on the LLM-native paradigm shift: a bounded-register search-decision runner was implemented and dry-run validated, while external benchmark harnesses were corrected to Reasoning Gym and AgentsNet after inspecting their repositories.

code_added_used.change: Adds the LLM-native bounded-register search-decision pilot: symbolic assignment/domain/conflict state, LLM branch/backtrack decision prompts, R sweep over {0,2,4,8,16,32}, llm/oracle/random backtrack-source contrast, checkpoint/resume, dry-run mode, claim summaries, and external benchmark harness metadata.

External repo cloned and inspected outside the worktree. Relevant harness API is reasoning_gym.create_dataset(...) plus dataset.score_answer(answer, entry); eval/AsyncModelEvaluator supplies async OpenAI-compatible concurrency and resume. Relevant tasks are graph_color and zebra_puzzles.

External repo cloned and inspected outside the worktree. Relevant harness API is LiteralMessagePassing with synchronous rounds, transcripts, parsing fallbacks, and task score functions; main.py loads graph instances from disco-eth/AgentsNet. Relevant task for this line is coloring.

Adds the official Reasoning Gym graph_color integration runner: instances come from reasoning_gym.create_dataset, final solve validation uses dataset.score_answer only, and the bounded-register search loop supplies branch/backtrack decisions over an R-limited view.

headline.single_next_move: Restart vLLM on a memory-clean GPU set or lower utilization, then run a single-request structured-call probe before resuming the real LLM-native pilot.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish the LLM-native bounded-register claim on a real LLM. It records harness implementation, external benchmark correction, and a no-LLM sanity pass only.
honesty.real_llm_limit: The real Qwen/vLLM pilot did not complete beyond the R=0 checkpoint rows because port 8001 became unresponsive and the restart failed on insufficient free GPU memory.
honesty.external_validity_limit: Reasoning Gym and AgentsNet were inspected and identified as the correct external benchmark harnesses, but no external benchmark slice has been run yet.
honesty.scope_limit: The original runner still uses separator graph-color instances for the internal bounded-register search pilot; the new official-harness runner starts with Reasoning Gym graph_color, while zebra_puzzles and AgentsNet integration remain subsequent execution steps.
